name: io.pingcore.sdk
description: Runtime SDK for PingCore game servers: Discovery (server list, reservations, quick join, matchmaking tickets), the self-hosted heartbeat tier, and the local SDK shim for PingCore-hosted fleet game servers, with optional Netcode for GameObjects connection approval.

samples.description: Beacon Rush on PingCore in one scene: an anonymous player token, a matchmaking ticket and a Netcode for GameObjects join into your own Beacon Rush fleet, plus a LAN game on your own PC. Needs Netcode for GameObjects 2.11.2. Import it, open Quickstart.unity and press Play.
